faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur Project Associate-II - Research recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Project Associate-II - Research position at IIT Kharagpur is 07 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-II - Research post?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria include a four years Bachelors Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences, Masters Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences, BVSc/BPharm, or a Bachelors degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine or equivalent, along with two years of R&D experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate-II - Research position is 40 years. However, age relaxation may be applicable based on sponsor agency rules.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates applying for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-II - Research role?
faq.answer: The salary offered is up to Rs.42,000/- + HRA for candidates selected through national-level examinations like CSIR-UGC NET or GATE, and Rs.33,000/- + HRA for others.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-II - Research post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate-II - Research position at IIT Kharagpur.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website of IIT Kharagpur.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Associate-II - Research position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves national-level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions, applicable to both CSIR-UGC NET/GATE qualified candidates and others.
